title: Audio event and state mapping
inputs: Fix donor master/mix settings and document recording device and sample rate
Capture starter, idle, load, gear and interior/exterior state changes
Capture representative surface, impact, rain and indoor/outdoor transitions
expected: Relative level and filtering observations without treating them as production assets
External raw recordings referenced by session/evidence ID and kept outside Git
toleranceNotes: At least five repetitions for short events. Audio clips are reference evidence only; no donor audio payload enters production Assets or Git.
